summary: Unchanged re-submission for record continuity; no new content is proposed and no further experiment is needed within this run. The snapshot-boundary line is closed with everything recorded in update-19.json: the two Behaviors describing installSnapshot leaving a stale same-index term and getLastEntry resolving that tie in favour of the log term; the retained witnesses and controls for the unrepairable-follower loop, strictly scoped to TrailingLogs=0 with a snapshot taken at the log end (CheckRun 72367650c8d0470d8197a7d2c0f97ce1 for the boundary rejection, 7772ad1b5b154d498a27a79806bb0ea7 for the single-peer loop, f66fa4e4e0514f7e95b7788032144a30 for the produced five-node history, beca431464bf44ab9c3354145c21899f for the cause-isolating control); the in-place revisions of the two Facts whose premises did not survive, including the incomplete-partition artifact and the compaction-condition sufficiency claim, now at revision 4 of 0b99111e65eb4d9faae97028d6140ff5-knowledge-0 which cites the retained backlog receipt; and the open items left for a future session, namely the unexplained repair path of the backlog peer (its store ended at 61..62 against the leader's 63..64 at the same applied index, consistent with the peer snapshotting on its own under the shared small SnapshotThreshold) and the never-executed default TrailingLogs case with a matching backlog. Necessary gaps remain registered with their owners, and the honest limits are stated in the consolidation: all evidence is in-process five-node with in-memory transports and stores on frozen snapshot fd2d6988362c434e9fda87b87c5fb0df, the finding must not be widened beyond TrailingLogs=0 with a snapshot taken at the log end, and human offline review owns final defect validity, CFT relevance and deduplication.
